device_label: 500 um SiN-WS2-HfO2-ITO capacitor phase shifter, unbalanced MZI, unclad
electrode_metal: Ti/Au (30 nm / 50 nm) contacts to WS2 and ITO; sputtered ITO top gate
cladding: None over the capacitor (unclad); 260 nm planarized PECVD SiO2 and 45 nm ALD Al2O3 between SiN and WS2
epitaxy_or_stack: SiN (1 um x 360 nm) / 260 nm SiO2 / 45 nm Al2O3 / CVD monolayer WS2 / 26 nm ALD HfO2 / sputtered ITO
notes: Unbalanced MZI (200 um arm imbalance, fringe visibility 0.98) with the voltage applied to the capacitor on the longer arm only. VpiL quasi-static from DC-biased spectra (frequency not stated); voltage swing -8 to 9 V, charge neutrality near -4 V; Delta n_eff 7e-4 at an 8 V swing, mode overlap 0.016 percent (p.7). Wavelength 1550 nm is the bandwidth measurement; the VpiL spectra span 1520 to 1600 nm. The device behind the 0.3 GHz measurement has no stated length. Bandwidth measured at 0 V DC with -10 dBm RF, 50 ohm source (p.16). No insertion loss reported. Monolayer WS2: eo_material graphene_2d (the 2D-material class), eo_effect other (gate-induced electro-refraction below the exciton).

device_label: 500 um SiN-WS2-HfO2-ITO capacitor phase shifter, unbalanced MZI, SU-8 clad

epitaxy_or_stack: SiN (1 um x 360 nm) / 260 nm SiO2 / 45 nm Al2O3 / CVD monolayer WS2 / 26 nm ALD HfO2 / sputtered ITO / SU-8
notes: SU-8 high-index cladding raises the WS2 mode overlap from 0.016 to 0.03 percent and Delta n_eff from 7.1e-4 to 1.35e-3 (p.7), cutting VpiL from 1.33 to 0.8 V cm. No bandwidth is attributed to this device in the body: Fig. 3(d) is the unclad device, while the abstract pairs 0.8 V cm with 0.3 GHz. Whether this is the unclad chip re-measured after SU-8 or a separate chip is not stated. Wavelength not stated for this measurement (MZI fringes 1520 to 1600 nm), so wavelength and band are empty. No insertion loss reported.

device_label: 4.5 mm HZO/Al2O3-clad SiN phase shifter in asymmetric MZI
cladding: 600 nm PECVD SiO2 passivation over the HZO/Al2O3 stack
epitaxy_or_stack: Si / 4 um thermal SiO2 / 330 nm PECVD SiN / 3 x [10 nm Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 + 1 nm Al2O3] ALD, conformal / 600 nm SiO2
notes: No Vpi: the metric is a non-volatile effective-index change, Delta n_eff about -1.5e-4 retained at 0 V after the first 210 V (Fig. 3(c)); it is negative for either field direction, absent from 0 to 120 V on the pristine device and only occurs once (later sweeps show a small positive Kerr-type change of the SiN). Mechanism by the authors: polarization-axis rotation and birefringence of orthorhombic HZO; Pockels effect not observed. Retention flat to 10,000 s after 120 V or 160 V; retained Delta n_eff about -0.2e-4 (120 V) and -1.55e-4 (160 V), read from Fig. 3(d) (text 'Figure 4d' = Fig. 3(d)). Fig. 3(b) bias on the longer arm (4.5 mm); Fig. 3(c) bias on the shorter arm (length not labelled). HZO and SiO2 reference devices show a positive change about 10 times smaller. Applied bias up to 210 V (instrument limit); electrode spacing not stated. No insertion loss reported; prop_loss_db_per_cm is a straight test-waveguide value (see evidence note).
